title: Acacetin reverses hypoxic pulmonary hypertension by inhibiting hypoxia-induced proliferation of pulmonary artery smooth muscle cells via SIRT1-HMGB1 pathway.
authors: Wang, Hui; Peng, Li-Jing; Lu, Wang; Li, Gui-Rong; Zhao, Peng-Tao; Lv, Xing; Dong, Ming-Qing; Liu, Man-Ling
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物acacetin通过SIRT1-HMGB1通路抑制肺动脉平滑肌细胞增殖以逆转低氧性肺动脉高压，核心为小分子-蛋白互作与细胞信号通路，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Hypoxic pulmonary hypertension (HPH) is characterized by sustained elevation of pulmonary arterial pressure and vascular remodeling. The present study is to investigate the efficacy of acacetin on HPH and its potential molecular mechanism. C57/BL6 mice were exposed to hypobaric hypoxia for six weeks. At 4th week of hypoxia exposure, mice were administrated with the water-soluble prodrug of acacetin (5, 10, 20 mg/kg) or equivalent normal saline for another two weeks. The haemodynamic and pathohistological assessment were performed. Primary pulmonary artery smooth muscle cells (PASMCs) were cultured to examine the anti-proliferation efficacy of acacetin (0.3-3 muM). The activity and expression of sirtuin1 (SIRT1) acetylation and distribution of high-mobility group box 1 (HMGB1) were determined in lungs and/or cultured PASMCs with or without RNA interference of SIRT1. Macromolecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation were done to explore the potential binding between acacetin and SIRT1. Results showed that acacetin prodrug significantly reversed the increased pulmonary pressure and vascular remodeling in HPH mice, which is associated with inhibiting the reduction in SIRT1 and the increase in HMGB1, and inhibiting the nucleocytoplasmic translocation of HMGB1. In cultured PASMCs, acacetin inhibited the hyper-proliferation induced by hypoxia, reversed the SIRT1 reduction and inhibited the nucleocytoplasmic translocation of HMGB1 and HMGB1 increase. Silencing SIRT1 abolished all the beneficial effects of acacetin. These results demonstrate that acacetin is very effective in reversing HPH by inhibiting PASMC hyper-proliferation via regulating SIRT1-HMGB1 signaling, suggesting that acacetin is likely a promising drug candidate for treating patients with HPH.
abstract_zh: 低氧性肺动脉高压（HPH）以肺动脉压持续升高和血管重塑为特征。本研究旨在探讨金合欢素对HPH的疗效及其潜在分子机制。C57/BL6小鼠暴露于低压低氧环境六周。在低氧暴露的第4周，给予小鼠水溶性金合欢素前药（5、10、20 mg/kg）或等量生理盐水，持续两周。随后进行血流动力学和组织病理学评估。培养原代肺动脉平滑肌细胞（PASMCs）以检测金合欢素（0.3-3 μM）的抗增殖效果。在肺组织和/或培养的PASMCs中，通过或不通过SIRT1的RNA干扰，测定sirtuin1（SIRT1）乙酰化的活性与表达，以及高迁移率族蛋白B1（HMGB1）的分布。通过大分子对接和分子动力学模拟探索金合欢素与SIRT1之间的潜在结合。结果显示，金合欢素前药显著逆转了HPH小鼠中升高的肺动脉压和血管重塑，这与抑制SIRT1减少和HMGB1增加，以及抑制HMGB1的核质转位相关。在培养的PASMCs中，金合欢素抑制了低氧诱导的过度增殖，逆转了SIRT1减少，并抑制了HMGB1的核质转位和HMGB1增加。沉默SIRT1消除了金合欢素的所有有益效果。这些结果表明，金合欢素通过调节SIRT1-HMGB1信号通路抑制PASMC过度增殖，从而有效逆转HPH，提示金合欢素可能是治疗HPH患者的有前景的药物候选物。
